watchPoints.text: Lisnagar Fortune's lead is uncontested on paper but watch for the cluster of displaced prominent types — Radar Ahead, Midnight Moonshine and Mavetherave — pushing forward at the start and crowding the early pace, which could disrupt the anticipated controlled shape entirely.

Outside The Door has strong course-and-distance form but has not run for 65 days; watch for any signs of ring-rustiness in the early stages — if the ten-year-old travels fluently in the first circuit, their stamina profile over 3m½f becomes very relevant late.

Jisco Du Brem's jockey, Alan O'Sullivan (5lb claimer), is a significant variable in a field this large — if the partnership is caught wide or loses position at a critical hurdle, the benefit of recent winning form could be wasted in a race where track position matters enormously.

Dorans Law and Whatsavailable are the two truest hold-up types in the race — if the pace does not genuinely stretch the field, both will be caught flat-footed for finishing speed, so the tempo set by Lisnagar Fortune across the final mile is the key variable for their winning chances.

runners_data.name: Caman Hill
runners_data.comment: A debut win that has since been franked by subsequent form marks him as a smart prospect, and he confirmed that promise when fourth, beaten 11 lengths, in a step up in grade under penalty in a bumper at Listowel last time. Course-and-distance form on ground he handles and clear room for improvement make him a big threat at 119.

runners_data.name: Dee Bee Zed
runners_data.comment: An eye-catching surprise on his only start, he won a bumper at Punchestown by three lengths on debut, a shock result that may still undersell his true ability. Course-and-distance form and ground he handles are in his favour, leaving him fairly assessed at 113 with more expected to come.

runners_data.name: Rokanako
runners_data.comment: Building on a debut experience, he took advantage of a pace meltdown to land a bumper at Kilbeggan by three lengths last time, though that form looks modest on inspection. He does have course-and-distance claims and acts well on this ground, but a rating of just 110 leaves him hard to fancy against this field.

runners_data.name: Fortysixnchange
runners_data.comment: A promising debut win in a bumper at Wexford by three lengths leaves room for more, even if that form carries a few question marks. His yard has landed this race before, and back after a break, he's a fair contender at 113.

runners_data.name: Begorrah Boy
runners_data.comment: A first-time runner out of a dam who failed to complete in points, he's by Conduit for a yard better known for point success but capable of readying sorts for a bumper debut. There's some interest in him at 111, though he remains up in the air on account of his complete lack of experience.

runners_data.name: Go Loud
runners_data.comment: Without a win in five runs, he shaped better than the result suggests when beaten seven lengths in a bumper at Punchestown last time, having shown a little promise in points before that. Course-and-distance conditions suit, and there should be more to come, leaving him with claims at 112.

runners_data.name: I Give Theorders
runners_data.comment: Rated on potential rather than the form shown, he was green and never involved in a bumper at Clonmel most recent, though that inexperience is easily forgiven. There's plenty for connections to unlock yet, and after a break to sharpen him, he's a leading contender at 115 - his modest form to date the obvious catch.

runners_data.name: Sir Vinny
runners_data.comment: An eye-catching third on his sole start, beaten just three and a half lengths in a bumper at Punchestown, points to a bright future. Conditions and course-and-distance form suit, and there should be more to come with that debut experience now banked, making him a leading threat at 118.

runners_data.name: Woodie Wiley
runners_data.comment: Little to work with so far, he was travelling in midfield at a big price when he lost his footing mid-race on his bumper debut, and drew a blank in his point starts beforehand. There's not much evidence to build a case on, leaving him one to monitor rather than fully trust at 115.

runners_data.name: Yanure
runners_data.comment: Winless in two starts, he couldn't build on a strong debut when down the field in a bumper at Thurles last time, and returns now after a lengthy break. That solid opening effort suggests a bounce-back is possible, and course-and-distance conditions are in his corner, but a rating of just 110 makes him hard to trust.

runners_data.name: Hot Rock Harry
runners_data.comment: Overly keen and well beaten on his only start, in a bumper for four-year-olds at Down Royal, he clearly has more to offer for a powerful stable. His connections have a solid record in this event, and course-and-distance conditions suit, but a modest rating of 105 leaves him with a mountain to climb.

runners_data.name: Mr Enigma
runners_data.comment: A half-brother to Fourtowns, who was fair over two miles, he's out of a dam placed in a bumper and bred by Pillar Coral. With no racing form yet to judge, he's one to note on debut rather than fully trusted at 115.

runners_data.name: Mila Ballerina
runners_data.comment: Raw and well beaten on her only start, in a bumper at Punchestown, she clearly needed that experience under her belt. First-time visor and a fresh opportunity give her a chance to progress, but she still has plenty to prove at 115 after that below-par debut.

runners_data.name: Pamelaisbrass
runners_data.comment: Well beaten on her sole start, in a bumper at Naas, she has a stack of ground to find on that evidence. A lengthy break since could bring improvement, but with major progress still needed, she's up against it at 115 on what she has shown so far.

runners_data.name: Silk Buds
runners_data.comment: A creditable third, beaten eight and a quarter lengths, in a maiden bumper at Kelso last time hinted at more to come after a flawed debut. Course-and-distance conditions suit and she's fresh from a break, but a modest rating of 107 leaves her with work to do against this field.

runners_data.name: Kingside Lady
runners_data.comment: Boosted form from a six-length win in a maiden at Ballindenisk gives her a standout profile, and she joins a yard capable of producing first-time-out bumper winners, with a strong record in this race too. On all known evidence she's the one to beat at 128, with the step up into this company the only thing left to confirm.
